note: PLT-04 permission audit (NFR-TST-03 invariant 4). Every permission PLT-04 allows has an entry; declared:true entries must be in the desktop entry's [X-Sailjail] Permissions= and map to a feature flag and to code that uses the permission. A permission with no feature is not declared. Edit together with docs/PLATFORM_CHECKS.md and tests/privacy/network_allowlist.json (build_permissions). Checked by tools/platform_check.py permissions.

core.network.description: Search, video details, stream resolution (yt-dlp child and the shared fast path), DASH manifests, thumbnails and downloads. Compiled into every variant.

core.playback.description: Audio and video output through the app's own GStreamer player (FULL; the STORE build compiles it out until the reduced Qt Multimedia path exists, E9) and MPRIS controls through Amber.Mpris. Compiled into every variant.

downloads.userFolders.description: DL-06: besides the private AppDataLocation/downloads default, the download-folder setting offers the user's Videos, Music and Downloads folders and mounted SD cards (/run/media/<user>/*), each write-probed when chosen. Compiled into every variant.

library.fileImportExport.description: IMP-01/IMP-02: import from a file the user picks (Sailfish.Pickers FilePickerPage, or a typed ~/ path) and export a backup into a folder the user picks (FolderPickerPage). Compiled into every variant.

downloads.mediaIndexing.description: Downloads appear in the system galleries (tracker indexing). Not built.

account.secretsVault.description: ACC-10 Sailfish Secrets vault. Not built.

account.webViewSignIn.description: ACC-05 embedded WebView sign-in, only after experiment E1. Not built.

Internet.feature: Network access for search, details, stream resolution, manifests, thumbnails and downloads

Audio.feature: Audio and video playback through the app's GStreamer player (pulsesink, the audio resource) and MPRIS media controls (Amber.Mpris)

Videos.feature: DL-06 download target: the user's Videos folder
Videos.gap: the DL-06 folder choice lists ~/Videos; under Sailjail without Videos the write probe refuses it (handled error, not a crash)

Music.feature: DL-06 download target: the user's Music folder (audio-only downloads)
Music.gap: the DL-06 folder choice lists ~/Music; under Sailjail without Music the write probe refuses it

Downloads.feature: DL-06 download target ~/Downloads, and importing from / exporting to files the user picks (IMP-01, IMP-02)
Downloads.gap: under Sailjail without Downloads the DL-06 ~/Downloads choice is refused and the import/export pickers cannot reach ~/Downloads (Takeout and NewPipe archives usually sit there); not in the PLT-03 'lost' list

RemovableMedia.feature: DL-06 download target on a mounted SD card (/run/media/<user>/*)
RemovableMedia.gap: the DL-06 folder choice lists SD cards; under Sailjail without RemovableMedia /run/media is not visible, so no card is offered

MediaIndexing.feature: Downloads appear in the system galleries

WebView.feature: Embedded WebView sign-in (ACC-05), only after E1 passes
